full_details: You ate at Mistress Ansell's before church. Breakfast was threepence. Gib stayed on the thin book, and the blank under Saturday's rule stayed blank. You said the king was still coming down, and that you would not open the page before church. She did not measure the loaf again. At St Helen's you kept the south aisle and brought no number home. After noon you looked at the Flint leaf and wrote "leave it" in the margin. At the Split Hazel Thomas Nashe came from Paul's with a grievance. Will Kemp mended one image into a salt-fish, and Nashe took the mend. You spoke to keep it going. Alice Brambleby set down two shillings and eightpence, and the jug. Nashe had not got the money, and he admired the paper. You did not write a half.
one_sentence: You left the king coming down, stood through church, and scarcely spoke at a supper whose bill was two shillings and eightpence, and the jug.
title: Threepence at breakfast, and two shillings eightpence at supper
